name: Timeout - Synthesize Partial Results
description: When a researcher loop approaches its iteration limit without completing, trigger synthesis with whatever evidence has been collected so far. Better to return partial findings than nothing.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.$entity.task_id.partial-synthesis
on_enter.prompt:
A research agent timed out after exhausting its iteration budget. Synthesize whatever evidence has been collected so far.

Task ID: $entity.task_id

Query the graph for entities with predicate research.has_evidence linked to this task. Produce a partial report clearly marked as PARTIAL, noting which areas still need investigation.
